_comment: Curated zapret2 (nfqws) desync strategies. Each id once active is written into the nfqws command line. Special strategy 'none' disables nfqws. The web panel switches between these live (change -> restart nfqws).
_no_reasm_note: A TLS strategy may set "no_reasm": true (optionally with "no_reasm_payloads": "tls_client_hello,quic_initial") to add --reasm-disable=... to the nfqws command line. Without it nfqws buffers and DROPS every packet of a TLS connection until the whole ClientHello reassembles; when a segment of a multi-segment ClientHello is lost the connection hangs forever (log lines 'DELAY desync until reasm is complete (#N)') - typical on low-MSS paths to YouTube/Google CDN hosts. no_reasm makes nfqws desync the first segment immediately and pass the rest through.

strategies.name: Standard (fake+multidisorder/multisplit, MD5 fooling)
strategies.desc: zapret default tactics. Recommended first try.

strategies.name: Fake only (repeats)
strategies.desc: Minimal: sends fake packets ahead of the real one.

strategies.name: Fake multisplit (MD5)
strategies.desc: Fakes + split TCP stream into multiple segments.

strategies.name: Fake multidisorder (badseq)
strategies.desc: Fakes + segments reordered with bad sequence numbers.

strategies.name: Fake + fakedsplit (MD5)
strategies.desc: Fakes plus replay of the first data chunk.

strategies.name: Split (no fakes)
strategies.desc: Pure TCP segmentation, no fake packets.

strategies.name: A/B (fake multi)
strategies.desc: fake,multisplit with method+2 on 443; often good for video hosts.

strategies.name: Disabled (passthrough)
strategies.desc: nfqws is stopped; firewall does not divert traffic. Use for diagnostics.

strategies.name: Custom: youtube.com (HTTPS/TLS1.2)
strategies.desc: Imported from youtube.com test results (100.0% success, 269ms latency). no_reasm: desyncs the first ClientHello segment immediately instead of buffering the whole hello (prevents connection hangs on low-MSS paths).
